parentItem.name: Assembled Mid-Weight Spear
parentItem.description: A seasoned ash shaft six feet long, the mid-weight iron tip road-lashed at the socket throat — wide-cut blade, cross-guard shoulder, oiled leather binding gone dark with handling. Four rune-threads seated and answering: ironsense along the shaft as anchor, Huginn's Ashwarden ending-sense worked through the fuller, a shadow-harm focus cut at the quillon, and an order-sense capacitor closed on Pell's reading idiom. The Weirmark is drawn at the collar; the Shielding Word is spoken into the haft. Pell's maker's mark sits in the blade. A death comes off it dry — no blood in the channels.
parentItem.provenance: Reforged from a light hunting point to the mid-weight tip at Pell's forge; rune-bound and NAMED Memory at Pell's forge on World-day 14, Weirmark drawn and Shielding Word spoken. Further work on World-day 18 evening at the Fell Pell, with Huginn as witness at the stone ring, split off the shadow-twin — 'Yours to call. Mine to carry.'
parentItem.imagePrompt: A six-foot ash war-spear with a wide mid-weight iron blade, four faintly-glowing rune-threads worked into shaft, fuller, quillon and collar — one cold iron-grey, one ashen death-pale, one shadow-black, one ordered blue — a smith's maker's-mark stamped in the blade, dark oiled-leather binding, held upright in a dim forge at dawn. Runic, deathbound, real.

grants.name: Anchored Read
grants.effect: Read the structure of what the blade touches or points at — the order in a thing, a site, a foe's form. The spear is a reading instrument, not only a weapon.
grants.clamp: a read, not a strike — no damage, no compulsion

grants.name: The Ending Through the Blade
grants.effect: Reads endings through the fuller: a death taken with Memory is read cleanly and CLOSED — comes off the blade dry, no blood in the rune-channels. Extends Huginn's ending-texture through the collar rune at conserved cost.
grants.clamp: reads + closes an ending; does not itself deal extra damage

grants.name: The Shadow-Harm Strike (Palework channel)
grants.from: palework — rank 3 (Ashen Meridian braid: order_sense × palework)
grants.effect: The spear's offensive register: a strike routed through the shadow-harm focus at the quillon, Palework fed coordinates by the ironsense read — harm that OPERATES on what it's aimed at, not merely blunt force. The one grant that raises the weapon's effective strike.
grants.band: reasonable @ L29 / palework 3 + braid — CLAMPED: a focused strike, not an execute; no runaway scaling
grants.clamp: +strike through Palework, bounded by the daily-evolution ceiling; never an instakill

grants.name: The Held Read
grants.from: order_sense capacitor on Pell's idiom (Undying Ledger braid: deathsense × order_sense)
grants.effect: Holds one order-read charged in the capacitor — a reading seated earlier can be released later, on Pell's idiom. Memory remembers one thing at a time.
grants.clamp: holds ONE read; releasing spends it

derivedInto: memory_shadow_twin (the Called Spear — a PEER, not a lesser echo)

derivedItem.name: Memory's Shadow-Twin
derivedItem.description: The shadow-twin of Memory, split from it by further work at Pell's forge. No iron in it — a spear of bound shadow that Silas calls to his hand from any distance and can HURL, re-summoning it to throw again. Not a lesser echo of the iron Memory but its COMPLEMENT: where iron bites poorly — shadow-substance things, Zone-changed creatures, what has no ordinary body to wound — the shadow-spear bites TRUE, and it carries strange shadow-power on the throw. Pell holds the iron; Silas calls the shadow. Two bodies, one binding, each answering what the other can't.
derivedItem.provenance: Sealed from Memory at dawn on the completion of the rune-work — 'Yours to call. Mine to carry.' The physical Memory is in Pell's hand; this is Silas's to summon.
derivedItem.imagePrompt: A spear made of held shadow and faint rune-light, no metal — a translucent dark echo of a runic war-spear forming in an open hand, threads of cold light where the iron blade would be, summoned from nothing in a dim space. Shadow-craft, called, sealed.

grants.name: Call and Cast
grants.effect: Summon the shadow-spear to hand from any distance AND hurl it — it re-forms in the hand to be thrown again, repeatedly. A ranged, re-summoning strike the iron Memory can't make (throw a physical spear and it's gone; throw this and it comes back).
grants.clamp: the spear returns on call; the throw is a real strike, not a guaranteed hit

grants.name: Shadow Bite
grants.effect: Bites what IRON bites poorly — shadow-substance creatures, Zone-changed things, the bodiless or half-there. Where Memory's physical blade finds nothing to wound, the shadow-spear finds purchase. Complementary damage type, not a weaker one.
grants.band: reasonable @ L29 / palework 3 — a DIFFERENT bite, on par with Memory's iron, against a different target class
grants.clamp: strong vs shadow/Zone-changed/bodiless; ordinary against what iron already handles (each spear excels where the other doesn't)

grants.name: Strange Shadow-Power on the Cast
grants.effect: The thrown shadow-spear carries shadow-power effects — the cast does more than land: it can carry a Palework-flavored consequence (a reading, a hindrance, an ending-touch) into the target on impact. The throw is a delivery, not just a spear.
grants.band: reasonable @ L29 — clamped to what Silas's palework rank supports
grants.clamp: one shadow-effect per cast, scaled to palework rank + the daily-evolution ceiling; not a free spell every throw

derivedItem.note: NOT weaker than Memory - DIFFERENT (Erik corrected). Complementary damage type + a thrown/re-summon mode the iron spear doesn't have.
derivedItem.effectiveness: PEER of the iron Memory, not a reduced echo. The two are a matched pair: Memory (iron) for ordinary bodies + the read/ending/held-read threads; the Called Spear (shadow) for shadow-substance/Zone-changed/bodiless foes + a thrown, re-summoning, shadow-effect-carrying strike. Neither is the 'main' — they answer different problems.

chronologyCorrection.resolved: Erik confirmed (his canon): NAMED Memory on World-day 14 (Weirmark + Shielding Word). Further work on World-day 18 — the SHADOW TWIN split. Not a drift: two real dates, d14 naming, d18 the twin. Record corrected.
